correctness.rationale: Read the actual definitions N[h]=V, N[v]={h} union B_i. If h is absent, L is empty and U records which peripheral cliques meet the subset, with fiber product of (2^s_i-1). If h is present, U=V and L records which cliques are full; complementary nonfull clique choices yield the other product. Exactly one observation (empty lower, full upper) occurs in both and its fibers combine to 2P; endpoints are two singleton fibers. Reconstruct the whole subproduct multiset, including empty and full products, and iteratively extract its least unaccounted factor; positivity a_i>1 and multiplicity accounting prove uniqueness even when factor products collide. Independently enumerated all original vertex subsets and resulting rough pairs for 35 r=2 or 3 clique-size profiles (sizes 2..4, total peripheral size<=11): complete multiplicity spectra agree in every case. The argument covers arbitrary admissible sizes, unlike finite checks.
